title: Three behavioural drifts can be read inside a 32-billion-parameter model as cleanly as inside a small one

charts.title: How well a simple reader separates the posture from neutral text (1.0 = always)
charts.note: Same texts for both models, five languages. The score is the chance that the reader ranks a text carrying the posture above a neutral one, measured on texts it was not fitted on.
